description: This file defines utility functions for interacting with HDFS in Spark Streaming, including reading/writing streams, checking file existence, and retrieving block locations.

methods.name: getOutputStream
methods.description: Returns an output stream for writing to the specified HDFS path, supporting append if available.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Returns an input stream for reading from the specified HDFS path, handling file not found and IO exceptions.

methods.name: checkState
methods.description: Checks a boolean condition and throws an IllegalStateException with a message if false.

methods.name: getFileSegmentLocations
methods.description: Retrieves the locations of HDFS blocks containing a specific file segment.

methods.name: getFileSystemForPath
methods.description: Returns the appropriate FileSystem object for a given Path, handling local file systems specially.

methods.name: checkFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path in HDFS.
